<member name="T:ViciOne.ServiceBus.Middleware.Outbox.OutboxConsumeContextProxy`1">
            <summary>Decorates a consume context so outgoing messages are captured by its owning outbox implementation.</summary>
            <typeparam name="TMessage">The consumed message contract.</typeparam>
        </member>

<member name="P:ViciOne.ServiceBus.Middleware.Outbox.OutboxConsumeContextProxy`1.IsMessageConsumed">
            <summary>Gets whether the owning implementation considers the inline consumption phase complete.</summary>
        </member>

<member name="P:ViciOne.ServiceBus.Middleware.Outbox.OutboxConsumeContextProxy`1.IsOutboxDelivered">
            <summary>Gets whether the owning implementation requires no further inline outbox delivery.</summary>
            <remarks>Reliable providers may delegate actual delivery to a separate owner; true is not proof of destination receipt.</remarks>
        </member>

<member name="P:ViciOne.ServiceBus.Middleware.Outbox.OutboxConsumeContextProxy`1.LastSequenceNumber">
            <summary>Gets the recorded inline delivery position, or null when no position is recorded or used.</summary>
        </member>

<member name="M:ViciOne.ServiceBus.Middleware.Outbox.OutboxConsumeContextProxy`1.SetConsumedAsync(System.Threading.CancellationToken)">
            <summary>Reports completion of consumption to the owning implementation.</summary>
            <remarks>The implementation controls storage; completion does not guarantee that an enclosing transaction has committed.</remarks>
            <param name="cancellationToken">The token used to cancel the operation.</param>
            <returns>A task that completes when the implementation has processed the consumption notification.</returns>
        </member>

<member name="M:ViciOne.ServiceBus.Middleware.Outbox.OutboxConsumeContextProxy`1.SetDeliveredAsync(System.Threading.CancellationToken)">
            <summary>Reports completion of inline outbox delivery to the owning implementation.</summary>
            <remarks>The implementation controls storage and may delegate delivery to another owner; completion is not a durable commit guarantee.</remarks>
            <param name="cancellationToken">The token used to cancel the operation.</param>
            <returns>A task that completes when the implementation has processed the delivery-completion notification.</returns>
        </member>

<member name="M:ViciOne.ServiceBus.Middleware.Outbox.OutboxConsumeContextProxy`1.NotifyOutboxMessageDeliveredAsync(ViciOne.ServiceBus.Middleware.OutboxMessageContext,System.Threading.CancellationToken)">
            <summary>Reports delivery progress to the owning outbox implementation.</summary>
            <remarks>
            Completion does not guarantee a durable checkpoint. An implementation may update tracked state
            for a later save and transaction commit, update process-local state, or require no delivery checkpoint.
            </remarks>
            <param name="message">The delivered outbox message.</param>
            <param name="cancellationToken">The token used to cancel the operation.</param>
            <returns>A task that completes when the implementation has processed the delivery notification.</returns>
        </member>

<member name="M:ViciOne.ServiceBus.Middleware.Outbox.OutboxConsumeContextProxy`1.RemoveOutboxMessagesAsync(System.Threading.CancellationToken)">
            <summary>Requests cleanup of the outgoing messages owned by this inline outbox.</summary>
            <remarks>Cleanup is implementation-specific and may require a later transaction commit or be handled by a separate delivery owner.</remarks>
            <param name="cancellationToken">The token used to cancel the operation.</param>
            <returns>A task that completes when the implementation has processed the cleanup request.</returns>
        </member>

<member name="P:ViciOne.ServiceBus.Middleware.OutboxConsumeContext.IsOutboxDelivered">
            <summary>Gets whether the owning implementation requires no further inline outbox delivery.</summary>
            <remarks>Reliable providers may delegate actual delivery to a separate owner; true is not proof of destination receipt.</remarks>
        </member>

<member name="P:ViciOne.ServiceBus.Middleware.OutboxConsumeContext.LastSequenceNumber">
            <summary>Gets the recorded inline delivery position, or null when no position is recorded or used.</summary>
        </member>

<member name="P:ViciOne.ServiceBus.Middleware.Outbox.InMemory.InMemoryOutboxConsumeContext`1.IsMessageConsumed">
            <summary>Gets whether consumption has been recorded in the process-local inbox entry.</summary>
        </member>

<member name="M:ViciOne.ServiceBus.Middleware.Outbox.InMemory.InMemoryOutboxConsumeContext`1.SetConsumedAsync(System.Threading.CancellationToken)">
            <summary>Records consumption in the process-local inbox entry at the current bus time.</summary>
            <param name="cancellationToken">The token used to cancel the operation.</param>
            <returns>A completed task after the timestamp has been stored.</returns>
        </member>

<member name="M:ViciOne.ServiceBus.Middleware.Outbox.InMemory.InMemoryOutboxConsumeContext`1.NotifyOutboxMessageDeliveredAsync(ViciOne.ServiceBus.Middleware.OutboxMessageContext,System.Threading.CancellationToken)">
            <summary>Advances the process-local delivery position to a delivered message.</summary>
            <param name="message">The delivered outbox message.</param>
            <param name="cancellationToken">The token used to cancel the operation.</param>
            <returns>A completed task after the delivery position has been advanced.</returns>
        </member>

<member name="M:ViciOne.ServiceBus.Middleware.Outbox.InMemory.InMemoryOutboxConsumeContext`1.RemoveOutboxMessagesAsync(System.Threading.CancellationToken)">
            <summary>Removes every outgoing message from the process-local inbox entry.</summary>
            <param name="cancellationToken">The token used to cancel the operation.</param>
            <returns>A completed task after the messages have been removed.</returns>
        </member>
